scope: Compiled runtime decoders, exact-path GET boundaries, local rewrite configuration and generated contract parity; injected transports only

checks.name: Foundation decoder admits current explicit sample and projects only known fields
Missing, wrong-type and overstated capability values fail before rendering
Dates reject invalid calendar values, ambiguous timezones and excessive precision
Health decoding distinguishes only supported bounded scopes
Only exact health GETs reach the normal same-origin transport
Unset local origin leaves deployment routing disabled
Local IPv4, hostname and IPv6 origins yield exactly three narrow rewrite rules
Remote, credential-bearing, malformed and path/query origins fail without rejected-value leakage
Generated TypeScript matches the saved actual OpenAPI document
